modmenu.descriptionTranslation.aftermath: Server-authoritative systems for a zombie-apocalypse survival modpack.

screen.aftermath.character.subtitle: Choose a profession and traits.
screen.aftermath.character.profession_hi: Choose your background and starting gear.
screen.aftermath.character.trait_hint: Click a trait to select or remove it.

profession.aftermath.medic.description: Starts with bread, honey bottles, and bandages.
profession.aftermath.mechanic.descriptio: Starts with a stone pickaxe, iron nuggets and sticks.
profession.aftermath.scavenger.descripti: Starts with an axe, bread and torches.
message.aftermath.learning.disabled: Learning is disabled on this server.
message.aftermath.learning.unavailable: This training material is currently unavailable.
message.aftermath.learning.wrong_manual: That manual does not match this lesson.
message.aftermath.learning.lesson_comple: You have already studied this manual.
message.aftermath.learning.program_compl: You have already watched this program.
message.aftermath.learning.tv_off_air: This program is off air. Field Medicine broadcasts at noon.
message.aftermath.learning.started: Started reading: %1$s. Time: %2$s sec. Stay still and avoid damage.
message.aftermath.learning.watching: Started watching: %1$s. Time: %2$s sec. Stay still and avoid damage.
message.aftermath.learning.cancelled_man: Learning session cancelled: you put the manual away.
message.aftermath.learning.cancelled_dam: Learning session cancelled: you took damage.
message.aftermath.learning.already_claim: The reward for this material has already been claimed.
message.aftermath.learning.status: Skill XP — first aid: %1$s; firearms safety: %2$s; mechanics: %3$s.
message.aftermath.noise.disabled: Noise events are disabled on this server.
message.aftermath.noise.unknown_event: The noise definition was not loaded. Check datapacks and restart the world.
message.aftermath.noise.cooldown: That noise event is on cooldown. Try again in a second.
message.aftermath.noise.emitted: Noise emitted. Existing eligible entities affected: %1$s; horde followers: %2$s.
message.aftermath.horde.enabled_temporar: Zombie group behavior enabled until the server stops. Now run /aftermath noise test.
message.aftermath.horde.disabled_tempora: Zombie group behavior temporarily disabled until the server stops.
message.aftermath.day.status: Apocalypse day: %1$s. Stage range: days %2$s–%3$s; detection radius ×%4$s; group size up to %5$s. Progression: %6$s.
message.aftermath.day.set: Apocalypse day set to %1$s. The value is saved with the world.
message.aftermath.weapon_held.none: No TaCZ gun recognized in your main hand. Hold a TaCZ gun and try again.
message.aftermath.weapon_held.inferred: inferred from ID; ambiguous names default to rifles
message.aftermath.bleeding.started: You are bleeding (severity %1$s). Use a bandage!
message.aftermath.bleeding.bandaged: Bandage applied. Bleeding severity is now %1$s.
message.aftermath.bleeding.disabled: Bleeding and first aid are disabled on this server.
message.aftermath.bleeding.status: Bleeding severity: %1$s/%2$s. Next blood loss in about %3$s sec.
message.aftermath.bandage.not_bleeding: You are not bleeding; the bandage was not used.
message.aftermath.first_aid.medic_treate: As a medic, you fully treated the bleeding with one bandage.
trait.aftermath.iron_stomach.description: Removes the vanilla Hunger effect while this trait is active.
trait.aftermath.keen_hearing.description: Selected footsteps, weapon and zombie sounds are louder on the client.
trait.aftermath.cat_eyes.description: Maintains Night Vision while this trait is active.
trait.aftermath.thick_skinned.descriptio: Takes 20% less damage from hostile mobs.
trait.aftermath.light_eater.description: Food exhaustion from normal actions is reduced by 35%.
trait.aftermath.speed_demon.description: Movement speed +5%; vehicle-specific bonuses are planned for Stage 5.
trait.aftermath.eagle_eye.description: Accuracy hook is defined; firearm spread integration arrives in Stage 4.
trait.aftermath.quick_reload.description: Reload hook is defined; firearm integration arrives in Stage 4.
trait.aftermath.deaf.description: Mutes every game sound category except MUSIC, including ambience, UI, mobs and modded sounds.
trait.aftermath.hard_of_hearing.descript: Relevant footsteps, weapon and zombie sounds are much quieter.
trait.aftermath.short_sighted.descriptio: Distant scenery becomes foggier using the standard viewport fog event.
trait.aftermath.cowardly.description: Nearby hostile mobs cause temporary Weakness and Nausea.
trait.aftermath.illiterate.description: Cannot start reading training manuals; TV learning remains available.
trait.aftermath.asthmatic.description: Sprinting adds extra food exhaustion and causes fatigue sooner.
trait.aftermath.sleepyhead.description: The trait is registered for the future sleep/fatigue system; its gameplay effect is not wired yet.
message.aftermath.learning.illiterate: You cannot read training manuals with the Illiterate trait.
screen.aftermath.character.error.profess: This trait requires a different profession.
profession.aftermath.police_officer.desc: Starts with a sword, shield, bread and torches. Keen Hearing is granted.
profession.aftermath.firefighter.descrip: Starts with an axe, protective gear, water and first-aid supplies. Fit is granted.
profession.aftermath.military.descriptio: Starts with a crossbow, arrows, armor and a sword. Strong is granted.
profession.aftermath.cook.description: Starts with a campfire, cooked food and tools. Iron Stomach is granted.
profession.aftermath.engineer.descriptio: Starts with tools and redstone supplies for repairs. Dextrous is granted.
profession.aftermath.homeless.descriptio: Gets extra trait points but only improvised tools, scraps and limited food. Clumsy is a free drawback.
profession.aftermath.farmer.description: Starts with seeds, vegetables and a hoe. Light Eater is granted.
profession.aftermath.driver.description: Starts with a compass, map and minecart; begins at Driving level 1. Speed Demon is granted.
